newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Foreign minister berates Serbian "brutality".
newsitem.headline: Irish Foreign minister berates Serbian "brutality".

text.p: Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring on Tuesday "utterly condemned the use of force against protesters in Serbia."
"Responsibility for the latest violence rests quarely with Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic," he said in a statement after riot police used force to quell street demonstrations.

Spring said "police brutality against peaceful demonstrators and journalists in Belgrade in recent days as well as reports of violence in other cities last week....is likely to aggravate the situation and deepen political tensions."
